arxiv-2404-16471.title: COBRA - COnfidence score Based on shape Regression Analysis for quality assessment of object pose estimation

arxiv-2404-16471.description: Abstract We propose a generic procedure for assessing 6D object pose estimates. Our approach relies on the evaluation of discrepancies in the geometry of the observed object, in particular its respective estimated back-projection in 3D, against a putative functional shape representation comprising mixtures of Gaussian Processes, that act as a template.

arxiv-2406-01536.creator: Frédéric Courbin
arxiv-2406-01536.description: Abstract Recent studies of wide binary stars based on Gaia DR3 suggest that the relative orbital velocities of objects with separations s > s> 3’000 astronomical units are statistically larger than the standard Newtonian predictions. Obviously there is no Dark Matter halo arround binary stars that could be invoked to explain these high velocities.

arxiv-2503-13382.title: Approximating Kemeny’s constant via spectral sparsification
arxiv-2503-13382.creator: A. Abiad, Á. Carmona, A. M. Encinas, M. J. Jiménez, Á. Samperio
arxiv-2503-13382.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by A. Abiad, Á. Carmona, A. M. Encinas, M. J. Jiménez, Á. Samperio. Kemeny’s constant of a network quantifies the expected time for a random walk to reach a target vertex chosen according to the stationary distribution, independently of the starting vertex. The purpose of this work is twofold. First, we introduce the class of slightly regular networks, whose orthogonal degree vector is an eigenvector of the Laplacian, and derive an exact expression for Kemeny’s constant for this class, extending previous results beyond regular networks.

arxiv-2508-10854.title: Introducing CQ: A C-like API for Quantum Accelerated HPC
arxiv-2508-10854.creator: Oliver Thomson Brown, Mateusz Meller, James Richings
arxiv-2508-10854.description: Abstract . In this paper we present CQ, a specification for a C-like API for quantum accelerated HPC, as well as CQ-SimBE, a reference implementation of CQ written in C99, and built on top of the statevector simulator QuEST ( Jones et al. 2019 ; Jones et al. 2025 ) .

arxiv-2509-25073.title: An empirical study on the limitation of Transformers in program trace generation
arxiv-2509-25073.creator: Simeng Sun
arxiv-2509-25073.description: Abstract We study Transformers on the task program trace generation (PTG), where models produce step-by-step execution traces for synthetic programs. Unlike existing algorithmic problems, PTG externalizes reasoning through long traces where each step is trivial. We train small Transformers with diverse modifications, including alternative position encodings, softmax replacements, hybrid model, and short convolutions.

pmc-10725560.creator: Mei-Qi Yang, Ming-Jun Sun, Hui-Jing Zhang
pmc-10725560.description: BACKGROUNDEsophageal carcinoma is a highly aggressive digestive cancer responsible for a notable proportion of cancer-related deaths worldwide. In this case review, we aim to summarize the metastatic characteristics of intramural gastric metastasis (IGM) in mucosal esophageal squamous carcinoma.

pmc-10738409.description: Levels of nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) decline by up to 50% in aging. NAD+ is an essential co-factor for many metabolic processes, including the deacetylase activity of sirtuins, and previous studies have demonstrated that supplementing NAD+ levels has a range of health benefits in both mice and humans.

pmc-11510013.title: Understanding Viral Haemorrhagic Fevers: Virus Diversity, Vector Ecology, and Public Health Strategies
pmc-11510013.creator: Roger Hewson
pmc-11510013.description: Viral haemorrhagic fevers encompass a diverse group of severe, often life-threatening illnesses caused by viruses from multiple families, including Arenaviridae, Filoviridae, Flaviviridae, Hantaviridae, Nairoviridae, Peribunyaviridae, and Phenuiviridae. Characterised by fever and haemorrhagic symptoms, these diseases challenge public health systems by overwhelming healthcare facilities, complicating diagnostic processes, and requiring extensive resources for containment and treatment, especially in resource-limited settings.

pmc-12428476.title: Case Report: A case of complex cortical dysplasia with central precocious puberty onset
pmc-12428476.creator: Chong Guo, Chunmei Chen, Xinrui Wang, Kaiwu Lin, Jingmin Guo, Pin Ge
pmc-12428476.description: A mutation rendering microtubulin and microtubule-associated proteins ineffective leads to a tubulinopathy known as complex cortical dysplasia (CCD), characterized by clinical heterogeneity and a variety of cortical brain developmental abnormalities. These often commence with intellectual disability, epileptic seizures, and motor disorders. In this case, we present a 6-year-old child with CCD whose symptoms began with central precocious puberty.

pmc-13051020.description: IntroductionNutrition sensitive urban agriculture that supports self‐determination for Aboriginal Peoples and Communities has the potential to promote food security, health, and wellbeing. This paper aims to (1) describe the evolving processes and pathways of a home gardening project development and (2) demonstrate the alignment of research practices with ethical principles for working and researching with Aboriginal Peoples and Communities.

pmc-13553700.description: IntroductionThe Lindop Parkinson’s Disease Mobility Assessment (LPA) is a Parkinson’s disease (PD)-specific clinical scale.
